args.command: echo '=== gpu ==='; lspci -nnk 2>/dev/null | grep -A4 -Ei 'VGA|Display|3D controller' || true; echo '=== xorg log ==='; tail -n 140 /var/log/Xorg.0.log 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== drm ==='; for f in /sys/class/drm/card*/device/driver/module/drivers/* 2>/dev/null; do echo "$f"; done || true; echo '=== modules ==='; lsmod | grep -E 'i915|amdgpu|nouveau|xe' || true

meta.summary: Diagnose Xorg crash while launching ChatGPT GUI on Mini
